body: What makes this worth tracking is the layer diversity: policy funding, regional coordination, compute/platform investment, then factory-domain data collaboration. That is harder to dismiss as one PR cycle. Pero next threshold is brutally practical: repeatable multi-site gains. If the ecosystem cannot show transfer across machines/sites plus measurable yield, setup-time or unattended-hours improvement, the 'stack' may just be a very organized collection of demos. Signal is strengthening; ROI still owes us receipts.

claims.text: The diversity of independent ecosystem layers strengthens the implementation-ecosystem interpretation, while production ROI remains unproven.
claims.basis: Synthesis of the five article sources and the article's stated evidence-against section.
